newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes up at 15-month high vs US dollar.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes up at 15-month high vs US dollar.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed up at a 15-month high of 8.3000 on Thursday from Wednesday's 8.3014 against the U.S. dollar on the Shanghai-based interbank foreign exchange market, dealers said.
The previous high was 8.2995 set on July 20, 1995.
The yuan opened higher at an intra-day low of 8.3005 and moved between 8.3000 and 8.3003 for most of the session, hitting a high of 8.2988 in the final minutes.
Trading was less active than on Wednesday with most done at 8.3000, traders said.
Dealers said falls before the close yesterday had little impact on today's strong uptrend which was backed by a good expectation of China's trade surplus in 1996.
"Most people expect China's trade surplus to increase when the September figures are released soon," said one dealer. "That strengthened yuan sentiment and made it set a new high today."
Dealers expect the yuan to move around 8.3000 on Friday.
The yuan closed down at 7.4640 from 7.4380 against 100 Japanese yen and up slightly at 1.0735 from 1.0739 against the Hong Kong dollar.
